title: FIG. 01 film plate
summary: Every interior page opens on the hero's frosted film as its own FIG. 01 plate, a closer crop of the same room. The founder's hero stack sits on it unchanged: red-square label, a 116px two-voice title (hero A's H1 size) ending in the light 'hears.', the red rule, the lede, both doors, and the engagement note bottom-right. The FIG. band's segmented control is the capability wayfinding (C·01 | C·02 | C·03), next to Pause film. It sits under the site nav (hero A's bar, with CAPABILITIES marked on the hairline). A hard cut to flat graphite then opens the first beat (label, a 40px two-voice statement over the red rule, the overview prose beside it), and the manifest starts as four hairline strips. Today's header is a photo strip over a boxed text column. This one is cinematic, shows you where you are among the three capabilities, and converts at the top.

reference.borrowed: Runway's structure: a warm, dark full-bleed film plate fills the top of the page under a transparent nav, then a hard horizontal cut drops to a flat field where the reading starts. Below the cut the page splits, with a statement on the left and quiet prose on the right. Runway's index of sibling pages becomes the capability switcher.
reference.kelwin: The plate is our frosted film reprised at a closer crop than the hero (the right half of the room, larger), so it reads as people: a man seen from behind fills cols 10–12, the standing colleague at col 9, and the seated figure behind the title. It is captioned as FIG. 01, with a mono caption and a Plurel-style segmented control in tracked caps (C·01 NARRATIVE | C·02 INFRASTRUCTURE | C·03 INTELLIGENCE), plus Pause film with its progress hairline. Runway's sibling-page index is now a control on the figure itself. The founder's hero DNA sits low-left on the film: label, two-voice wide title, a 48×2 red rule, a 20px lede, the red 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' and the underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →', and the bottom-right annotation. Runway's split is re-ruled to the A anatomy: a 40px two-voice statement over the red rule in cols 1–5 (a smaller heading, so the page keeps one big title), and the overview prose with its accent line in cols 7–12. The manifest starts as Metalab strips on full-height hairlines.

motion: entrance (header, about 1.8s): the film fades up, the nav fades in as its hairline draws and the current item's marker draws on it, and the label fades in (300ms). The title lines rise out of masks (800ms --ease-out), with the light 'hears.' landing 200ms behind. The red rule draws, then the lede, the doors and the annotation fade up 12px. The FIG. band hairline draws from margin to margin. Last, the active C·01 segment's fill wipes in from the left (900ms --ease-inout) as its label inverts to graphite.

entrance (body, from about 0.95s, as if crossing the cut): the label and meta fade in, the two-voice statement rises out of its masks (light line 200ms behind), the red rule draws, the prose and accent fade up, the opening hairline draws, and the three strip verticals draw top-down at a 120ms stagger while each strip's contents rise.
ambient: only the film (32s drift, a silhouette crossing, frosted grain) and the 1px progress hairline along the Pause film control's bottom edge. Nothing else loops.

interaction: 'Pause film' really pauses the plate drift, the walker, the grain and the progress hairline, and flips to 'Play film'. Hovering a strip lifts its title from --fg-2 to --fg. On the red CTA the fill deepens and ↗ moves 2px up-right. The secondary's underline turns --fg and its → moves 3px.

on the live site: the segmented control navigates to the sibling capability page (C·02 / C·03), where the film opens on that page's own crop of the room and the active fill slides to the new segment. The body reveals on scroll with the same choreography. prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state.
notes: Interior page header and first body beat, cropped to about 1395px. The manifest shows S·01–S·04 of 07, with '03 MORE →' in the S·04 strip as the crop cue. Coherence pass: the site nav is now drawn (hero A's bar: lockup, tracked-caps items, outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, with CAPABILITIES marked current on the hairline); the title is 116px like the hero's H1; the header spacing matches the hero (label 36 → title → 40 → rule → 28 → lede → 40 → doors). To keep header + first beat inside 1400px the body statement is a 40px smaller heading rather than a second 88px title, which also leaves the page one big title. The header is about 790px instead of the planned 640px, because it carries the nav and the founder's full hero stack, including both doors. Body top padding is 64px, because the hard cut already separates the acts. Copy is lightly edited from narrative-systems/page.tsx and capability-data.tsx: a shorter lede, prose trimmed to about 45 words, and S·04 shortened to 'Objection library' to fit a strip. Film: blur 8px, frost .20, brightness 1.2 (hero A's calibration), plate cropped to the right half of the room at about 0.76 scale.
